modules.title: Linux
modules.job: Run, inspect, and fix a Linux machine
modules.install: A Linux shell (Ubuntu 22.04+ or Debian, native / VM / WSL2) with sudo.

modules.title: Ansible
modules.job: Describe server setup as repeatable recipes
modules.install: Linux shell plus ansible on the control machine. Localhost is enough for first success.

modules.title: Docker
modules.job: Package an app and its dependencies into an image
modules.install: Docker Engine or Docker Desktop. Your user in the docker group.

modules.title: Kubernetes
modules.job: Run and heal many containers as one system
modules.install: Docker plus kind plus kubectl. Not kubeadm, not a cloud cluster.

modules.title: Terraform
modules.job: Declare infrastructure and let a tool converge it
modules.install: terraform or tofu. First success uses the local provider — no cloud account.

modules.title: Prometheus
modules.job: Pull metrics on a timer and ask questions of them

modules.title: Grafana
modules.job: Turn those metrics into dashboards and alerts
modules.install: Docker (same compose stack as Prometheus first success).

modules.title: GitHub Actions
modules.job: Run build, test, and deploy steps on a git event
modules.install: A GitHub account and a repo you can push to. No self-hosted runner required.

modules.title: Git
modules.job: Record file history so you, a teammate, and CI share one source of truth
modules.install: Linux shell plus git on the PATH. sudo apt install -y git if missing. No GitHub account for first success.

projects.title: Full CI/CD pipeline
projects.job: Build a tiny API, run it on kind, and read how GitHub Actions would ship the image.
projects.startWhen: Build an image, apply a Deployment on kind, read a workflow file

projects.title: Terraform + Ansible + Vault
projects.job: Create local infra with Terraform and configure it with Ansible before any Vault or GitLab CI.
projects.startWhen: terraform apply a local example; run a localhost playbook
